description: В начале 2026 года Турция поставила Украине «небольшое количество» зенитных комплексов Korkut, сообщает Middle East Eye (MEE) со ссылкой на источники. По их данным, полученные комплексы Киев использовал для испытаний и укрепления возможностей ПВО.

title: Israel puts military on alert for Oct 7 anniversary, warns Gazans
description: Israel’s military has been placed on high alert ahead of the first anniversary of the October 7 attack, with the defence minister warning of a ‘heavy price’ for any harm to Israeli forces, citing intelligence on potential Hamas terror operations.

title: Oil gains as traders weigh Gulf tensions against strong Mideast exports
description: SINGAPORE: Oil prices made slight gains on Tuesday as security concerns in the Middle East kept ​a geopolitical risk premium in the market, even as resilient regional crude exports and a ‌G7 emergency stockpile release eased supply concerns. title: Israeli documentary ‘NAZA’ opens in the US, reigniting debate over the war in Gaza
description: The U.S. release of the Israeli documentary ‘NAZA’ is reigniting debate over American military aid to Israel. The film features Israeli military insiders alleging the reckless killing of civilians in Gaza, claims the Israeli military denies.

title: War-weary northern Israelis rethink loyalty to Netanyahu before election
description: NAHARIYA, Israel: On Israel’s border with Lebanon where Hezbollah fired thousands of rockets and drones, previous backers of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu say they are rethinking how they will vote in the first election since the war. “Many I know were right-wing and were Bibi supporters, and today they’re not,” said plant nursery owner Sigal Malachi, using a nickname for Israel’s longest-serving premier. title: FBI arrests California woman accused of spying on Taiwan leader’s family for China
description: The FBI arrested a California real estate agent, Wanying Zhang, for allegedly spying on the family of Taiwan’s President Lai Ching-te on behalf of China. Zhang was apprehended at Los Angeles International Airport and is charged with working as an unregistered foreign agent.

title: Live: Tens of thousands expected at Paris protests as unions join students
description: Up to 40,000 people are expected to march in Paris on Tuesday as French trade unions join high school students protesting school conditions. The demonstrations have been marked by clashes with police, arrests, and injuries, including a 15-year-old student whose hand was blown off after he picked up a ‌police grenade. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

title: Ukraine hits Moscow with one of its largest drone attacks in two years
description: Ukraine launched overnight one of its largest drone attacks on Moscow in the past two years, killing two people and injuring several people in the Russian capital, local officials said on Tuesday.

description: A young mother has lost two husbands and two children during Israels genocidal war on Gaza.

title: Mexican and Colombian cartel mercenaries filmed fighting in Ukraine
description: Members of Mexican and Colombian cartels are reportedly joining Ukraine’s International Legion to learn drone warfare.

title: UN rights council condemns attacks on civilians in Sudan, calls for truce
description: Resolution demands an immediate ceasefire and extends the mandate of the mission investigating abuses in Sudan.

title: Turkiye, Pakistan to deploy forces to Saudi as Yemen fighting grows
description: During emergency talks in Riyadh, Turkiye and Pakistan agreed to send rapid deployment forces to Saudi Arabia.

title: Fort Hood shooter to be executed by firing squad - a first for US military since World War Two
description: Nidal Malik Hasan killed 13 unarmed soldiers and injured another 32 in the deadliest ever non-combat attack on an American military base.
